# George's of Galilee

> > Family-owned waterfront seafood restaurant in Narragansett, Rhode Island, serving award-winning sustainable seafood at the Port of Galilee since 1948.

George's of Galilee offers waterfront dining featuring fresh New England seafood, hosts special events including wine dinners, bourbon tastings, lobster boils, and murder mystery dinners, and sells branded merchandise through their online store. The restaurant operates a loyalty program called George's Rewards Card.

## Special Events & Experiences

- [Lobster Boil 3/13/26](https://www.georgesofgalilee.com/product/lobster-boil): New England-style lobster boil event with seafood and appetizers
- [Far Niente Wine Dinner](https://www.georgesofgalilee.com/event/auto-draft-2): Four-course wine dinner featuring Far Niente Napa Valley wines
- [Bourbon and Bites Tasting 4/19/26](https://www.georgesofgalilee.com/product/bourbon-and-bites-tasting): Bourbon tasting event with Woodford Reserve and food pairings
- [Sweet Revenge Murder Mystery Dinner](https://www.georgesofgalilee.com/event/auto-draft): 1920s Chicago-themed interactive murder mystery dinner experience
- [Murder Mystery Dinner 4/10/26](https://www.georgesofgalilee.com/product/murder-mystery-dinner): Mobsters, Molls, and Movie Stars 1920s murder mystery dinner event
- [Event Archives](https://www.georgesofgalilee.com/product-category/event): Archive of restaurant events including wine dinners and tastings
